Description: OpenLegend private asset storage and isolated study delivery; conditional immutable writes and short project-operator access.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: Separate library, studies, production, nonproduction, intake, recovery and audit boundaries; no gameplay authority.
must: All regional resources stay in the selected project Region.
Retain durable content; deletion and Git history rewriting are separately authorized.
Same-project recovery is not independent disaster recovery.
CloudFront logging v2 is configured by the CLI in its required us-east-1 control Region, delivering into the selected-Region log bucket.
Private study access covers only explicitly copied curated material; ordinary game/private-world permission remains server-owned.

ref.has: storage, publication, retention and recovery contracts

AllowedConsumerOrigins.Description: Exact game and tooling origins admitted for browser asset reads.

SignerSecretArn.Description: Existing secret JSON with privateKeyPem. No secret value belongs in the template.

SignerPublicKeyPem.Description: RSA2048 PUBLIC KEY PEM corresponding to SignerSecretArn; never pass the private key.

ExternalRuntimeBucket.Description: Existing production bucket served by assets.openlegend.ai; retained and owned outside this stack.

ExternalDistributionId.Description: Existing custom-domain CloudFront distribution; public study behavior is merged through the reviewed ETag guarded command.

Properties.FunctionCode: function handler(event) { var r=event.request; r.headers['x-openlegend-viewer-host']={value:r.headers.host.value}; return r; }

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Only the uncached login exchange forwards cookies, so CloudFront preserves its Set-Cookie response; query ticket and trusted viewer host are scoped separately.
Public media transport headers and CORS.
Isolated private tooling headers and CORS.
